## Controls

Updated 9 minutes ago

[View all](https://trust.dengage.com/controls)

[**Infrastructure security**](https://trust.dengage.com/controls#infrastructure-security)

- Unique production database authentication enforced

- Unique account authentication enforced

- Access revoked upon termination


[View 6 more Infrastructure security controls](https://trust.dengage.com/controls#infrastructure-security)

[**Organizational security**](https://trust.dengage.com/controls#organizational-security)

- Employee background checks performed

- Confidentiality Agreement acknowledged by contractors

- Confidentiality Agreement acknowledged by employees


[View 1 more Organizational security control](https://trust.dengage.com/controls#organizational-security)

[**Product security**](https://trust.dengage.com/controls#product-security)

- Control self-assessments conducted

- Penetration testing performed


[**Internal security procedures**](https://trust.dengage.com/controls#internal-security-procedures)

- Cybersecurity insurance maintained

- SOC 2 - System Description

- Whistleblower policy established


[View 17 more Internal security procedures controls](https://trust.dengage.com/controls#internal-security-procedures)
